fields.default: We leave a stamped card on every pillow. Some guests post them home, and some post them back to us.

default.quote: I came for one night on the coast path and stayed three. Your breakfast kippers have ruined all other breakfasts for me.

default.quote: Dog bed, dog towel and a sausage at breakfast. Biscuit has asked when we are going back.

default.quote: Thank you for drying our boots by the stove and for the hand-drawn map to the quiet beach.
